title: Differentiation of Human Embryonic Stem Cells into Oligodendrocyte Lineage Cells
author: Paria Pooyan
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bddni25e
materials: 6 ×10 6 RH6 cells were plated on Engelbreth-Holm-Swarm mouse sarcoma ECM (sigma) coated 6cm cell culture plates on day -1.

steps.title: Replace FFC medium with NI medium
steps.instruction: On day 0, replace the FFC medium (containing 20 % KSR and 100 ng ml⁻¹ bFGF) with 4 ml NI medium; refresh the NI medium every day.

steps.title: Gradually withdraw KSR from NI medium
steps.instruction: From day 4 to day 7, reduce KSR in the NI medium as follows: day 4 – 3.75 % KSR; day 5 – 2.5 % KSR; day 6 – 1.25 % KSR; day 7 – 0 % KSR (starting from a 5 % KSR withdrawal).

steps.title: Switch to N2 medium
steps.instruction: On day 8, replace the NI medium with N2 medium and refresh it daily.

steps.title: Loosen attachment and detach cells (day 12)
steps.instruction: On day 12, loosen cell attachment by adding PBS and incubating for 10 min; replace PBS with N2B27 medium; detach cells by gently breaking the layer with the tip of a p1000 pipette and pipette the clumps gently five times.

substeps.instruction: Add PBS and incubate 10 min to loosen attachment.
Detach cells by breaking the layer with the tip of a p1000 pipette and pipette the clumps gently five times.

steps.title: Form aggregates and refresh N2B27
steps.instruction: Transfer detached cells into untreated 6 cm plates to allow aggregate formation; from day 14 onward, refresh two‑thirds of N2B27 medium daily, removing debris and dead cells; break apart aggregates that stick together by gentle p1000 pipetting.

steps.title: Introduce PDGF medium (day 20)
steps.instruction: On day 20, replace two‑thirds of the N2B27 medium with PDGF medium; thereafter refresh two‑thirds of PDGF medium daily until day 80.

steps.title: Coat dishes with poly‑L‑ornithine and laminin
steps.instruction: On day 29, coat new 6 cm culture dishes overnight with 50 µg ml⁻¹ poly‑L‑ornithine in dH₂O at 37 °C; then coat with 20 µg ml⁻¹ laminin in PBS for 12 h at 37 °C.

steps.title: Plate aggregates on coated dishes (day 30)
steps.instruction: On day 30, plate golden or brown aggregates (with a dark centre) onto the poly‑L‑ornithine/laminin‑coated dishes using a p200 pipette, adding 50 spheres per 6 cm plate; continue gentle daily refresh of two‑thirds PDGF medium until day 80.

steps.title: Re‑plate for homogeneous OPCs (days 65 & 75)
steps.instruction: On day 65 and again on day 75, detach cells and aggregates with PBS and a p200 pipette, then re‑plate onto freshly poly‑L‑ornithine/laminin‑coated dishes to achieve a homogeneous OPC population by day 80.

steps.title: Switch to Glial medium (day 80)
steps.instruction: On day 80, replace the PDGF medium with Glial medium; refresh two‑thirds of the Glial medium every 2–3 days until day 120.
